title: Creamy Peruvian Chicken and Beans
description: A hearty and flavorful Peruvian-inspired dish featuring tender chicken and creamy navy beans.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned and cooked through.
Remove the chicken and set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until softened.
Add the aji amarillo peppers and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the hot sauce (if using), navy beans, and chicken broth.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes.
Stir in the peruvian crema and cook until heated through.
Return the chicken to the skillet and cook until coated in the sauce.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped onion and aji amarillo peppers (if desired).
